name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A 'Recovery keys' disclosure whose trigger button toggles a list of panel contents that animates open/closed via height transition, with a caret icon that rotates 90 degrees while the panel is open.
stateManaged: none — no open-state props (open, onOpenChange, defaultOpen) or demo state are passed; Collapsible.Root manages its own default closed state internally (uncontrolled by the library's default)
nonTrivialInteractions: Trigger click toggles the panel open/closed (native button semantics from Collapsible.Trigger)

Panel animates height between 0 and var(--collapsible-panel-height) using data-starting-style/data-ending-style (h-0) with a 150ms ease-out transition, driven by the --collapsible-panel-height CSS variable the library exposes
Caret icon rotates 90deg when the panel is open via the group/data-panel-open pattern (group-data-panel-open:rotate-90 in tailwind; [data-panel-open] .Icon descendant rule in css-modules)
Closed panel is display:none'd only when fully hidden: [&[hidden]:not([hidden='until-found'])]:hidden keeps the panel visible if hidden='until-found' is ever set
